AVIATION — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Aviation Entrepreneurship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Entrepreneurship.

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Entrepreneurship.
